Job Description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Quality Engineer based in Netherlands.

The Senior Software Quality Engineer will take ownership of software quality strategy across a rapidly evolving cloud infrastructure platform, ensuring that reliability and testability are built into every stage of development. This role goes beyond writing test cases, combining hands-on automation engineering with architectural input and cross-functional leadership. The successful candidate will design scalable testing frameworks for backend services and user interfaces, integrate automated checks into CI/CD pipelines, and help engineering teams release changes with confidence. Working closely with engineering and product stakeholders, they will influence design decisions, identify risks early, and strengthen quality practices across multiple projects. The role also emphasizes practical use of AI-powered tools to improve testing workflows while maintaining strong technical judgment. It is an opportunity to make a significant impact in a remote-first, fast-moving technology environment focused on cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, and AI workloads.

Accountabilities

Lead the design, development, and maintenance of scalable automated testing frameworks covering backend services, user interfaces, and other critical product components. 
Define and own end-to-end test strategy across services and features, ensuring testing coverage aligns with product objectives, technical risks, and reliability expectations. 
Collaborate with engineering and product teams throughout the development lifecycle to establish quality standards, improve testability, and identify potential issues before implementation. 
Participate in architecture and design reviews, providing guidance on testability, system reliability, edge cases, and failure scenarios before code is written. 
Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent platforms to deliver fast and actionable feedback on code changes. 
Conduct exploratory testing to uncover usability problems, unexpected behaviors, edge cases, and regressions that automated tests may not detect. 
Apply AI-assisted workflows to review pull requests and design documents, develop test plans, generate test cases, and improve automation efficiency while independently validating results. 
Investigate complex backend, infrastructure, and distributed-system issues through systematic debugging, root-cause analysis, and collaboration with relevant engineering teams. 
Manage quality initiatives across multiple projects in a dynamic environment, balancing shifting priorities while maintaining rigorous testing standards. 
Advocate for continuous improvement in test automation, development workflows, and quality practices to support rapid delivery without compromising product reliability. 
Contribute to testing approaches for Kubernetes-based infrastructure and tenant-isolation environments as applicable. 
Help establish and scale QA practices that support product growth, operational resilience, and dependable customer experiences. 

Requirements

At least 7 years of professional experience in quality assurance, software testing, or test automation, including 2 or more years working at a senior or staff level. 
Strong hands-on programming skills in at least one of the following languages: Go, Python, or JavaScript, with experience building and maintaining automation frameworks and testing tools. 
Proven experience designing and owning test strategies across complex software systems, including automated testing for backend services and user interfaces. 
Strong understanding of CI/CD practices and practical experience integrating automated testing suites into pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or comparable tools. 
Regular experience using AI-powered tools to support software quality activities, such as code and design reviews, test planning, and test automation, with the ability to critically evaluate and verify AI-generated output. 
Working knowledge of Kubernetes environments and distributed systems, or the ability to develop this expertise quickly. 
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and debugging skills, particularly when investigating backend services, infrastructure components, and complex system behavior. 
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical risks, influence engineering decisions, and collaborate effectively with product and engineering stakeholders. 
Demonstrated ownership, initiative, and accountability, including the ability to identify problems independently and drive solutions through to completion. 
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment, navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and maintain attention to detail while working across several projects. 

Preferred Qualifications

Experience testing Kubernetes tenant clusters, tenant-isolation architectures, or similar multi-tenant infrastructure environments. 
Previous experience establishing or leading QA practices at a startup during a period of rapid product development or organizational growth. 
Interest in cloud infrastructure, open-source technologies, and platforms supporting AI and other demanding computing workloads. 

Benefits

Health and insurance coverage: Health, dental, vision, and life insurance, with coverage for eligible dependents where available. Benefits vary by country. 
Flexible working hours: A results-oriented environment that accommodates personal commitments and supports work-life balance. 
Remote-work flexibility: A distributed working model with flexibility in where and how work is performed, subject to applicable employment arrangements. 
Meaningful technical ownership: The opportunity to shape quality strategy, influence architecture, and build testing systems that support mission-critical infrastructure. 
Growth and development: Opportunities to expand expertise in test automation, Kubernetes, distributed systems, AI infrastructure, and AI-assisted engineering workflows. 
Collaborative culture: Work alongside technical teams that value initiative, accountability, knowledge sharing, and practical problem-solving.

Job Description:
At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car, a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton, Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe, we encounter exceptional objects every day.

We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.

Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.

Taking ownership and driving impact 
Being open to change and feedback
Being passionate about our mission and our customers. 

Your Mission

At Catawiki, our Platform Horizontal has evolved from solely managing the cloud into a broad function supporting Reliability, Developer Experience, Security, and Quality. We take a holistic approach to creating systems and tools that help developers deliver applications seamlessly and reliably without getting bogged down in infrastructure complexity.

As a Platform Engineer, you’ll work at the intersection of development, infrastructure, and operations. You’ll help shape and execute our long-term platform vision, empowering Catawiki teams to deliver value to customers with speed, reliability, and security.

What You'll Do

You’ll build and improve the platform capabilities that enable our engineering teams to develop, deploy, and operate applications effectively at scale.

Build a self-service developer platform with a particular emphasis on developer experience, designing and maintaining platforms that abstract complexity and give teams the tools to deploy, monitor, and optimise their applications.
Orchestrate cloud-native infrastructure, manage Kubernetes clusters and other cloud resources, focusing on performance, scalability, and cost efficiency through FinOps practices.
Boost developer productivity by building and enhancing CI/CD pipelines, GitOps workflows, and reusable templates that accelerate development and deployment cycles.
Drive reliability and scalability through applying practices for fault tolerance, disaster recovery, and scaling so applications run smoothly under changing conditions.
Improve platform operations usage and enhance our observability stack to monitor platform health and resolve incidents proactively.
Collaborate and innovate by partnering with product teams to understand their needs, build simple and impactful solutions, and champion cloud-native best practices across Catawiki.

What You'll Bring

You measure what matters, introduce changes gradually, and treat failure as a normal part of learning. You use tooling and automation wherever possible to reduce toil, and enjoy sharing knowledge with others.

Cloud-native expertise: At least 5 years of production experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, and cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.
Automation mindset: Experience automating workflows and CI/CD pipelines and working with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or Ansible.
Observability experience: Hands-on experience using and maintaining tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or OpenTelemetry to improve reliability and performance.
Strong ownership: You proactively address platform issues and work toward long-term scalability and resilience.
Collaborative approach: You work effectively with developers and cross-functional teams to align goals and deliver impactful yet simple solutions.
Continuous learning: You keep developing your knowledge of cloud-native tools, technologies, and practices in a fast-moving ecosystem.

How We Work

The Platform Horizontal supports engineering teams across Catawiki by reducing infrastructure complexity and providing reliable, secure, and scalable foundations.

We collaborate closely with product teams to understand their challenges and improve their development experience.
We favour self-service capabilities, reusable solutions, automation, and measurable, gradual improvements.
We share knowledge and treat reliability, security, quality, and developer experience as shared responsibilities.

Where You'll Be

This is a Hybrid role based in Amsterdam. You will work from our Amsterdam HQ a minimum of 2 days per week.

This role is open to candidates worldwide. For selected candidates, Catawiki can provide visa sponsorship and relocation support to the relevant location, subject to eligibility and applicable restrictions.

A Work From Home Allowance to help with your monthly household bills.
Commuting between your home and our office is covered by Catawiki.
Amazing Office right in the centre of Amsterdam.

Create a visible impact by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.
Learn and grow through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression.
A culture of connection defines us. We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work.
Celebrate life’s moments with us. You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion”. We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location.

Marktplaats is one of the Netherlands' leading online marketplaces, helping make commerce more sustainable by giving products an extended life. This role is on the internal IT side of that function, building the platforms and automation the whole company runs on.

You'll own the IT infrastructure, SaaS ecosystem, identity and access management, and automation for ~350 colleagues, reducing manual work, optimising processes, and building a setup that scales without adding complexity. Wat ga je doen

Voor het CBBS-team, zijn wij op zoek naar een (ruim) ervaren Testengineer. Deze Testengineer moet in staat zijn om functionele tests uit te voeren, testautomatisering (door)te ontwikkelen en te onderhouden.

Samen met jouw collega’s in een scrumteam draag je zorg voor het functioneren van de applicatie CBBS (Claim Beoordelings- en Borging Systeem). De applicatie CBBS is een hulpmiddel om de mate van arbeidsongeschiktheid van onze cliënten te bepalen en de uitkomsten in de vorm van rapporten van te leggen. De applicatie CBBS is daarom een belangrijk onderdeel van ons applicatielandschap, deze applicatie is essentieel in de Claimprocessen.

Ook zul je testwerkzaamheden uitvoeren voor de applicatie MOI SMBA.

Als Testengineer participeer je in een multidisciplinair Scrum-team, aangestuurd door een Product Owner, met een manager als hiërarchisch leidinggevende.

In de applicatie gedreven organisatie die UWV is, toets jij de werking en kwaliteit van de functionaliteit van het CBBS. Jij controleert de gerealiseerde oplossingen, hiervoor doe je het volgende:

Binnen je team bewaak jij de teststrategie en zorg je dat het team hiermee bekend is. 
Je ontwikkelt en beheert de geautomatiseerde tests. 
Je bepaalt testtechnieken en verwerkt deze in testgevallen. 
Je rapporteert over de testen en geconstateerde bevindingen. 
Je documenteert en updatet testdocumentatie ten behoeve van test-coverage en regressietesten. 
Je draagt bij aan oplossingsrichtingen in het gehele ontwikkelproces. 
Binnen de cluster ondersteun je (indien noodzakelijk) ook andere systemen bij testwerkzaamheden. 

Wat we van je verwachten

Je bent een zelfstarter, en je brengt energie mee. Je vindt het belangrijk om een bijdrage te leveren aan de toegevoegde waarde en kwaliteit van een nieuw of gewijzigd product. Dankzij jouw zorg voor kwaliteit ben je in staat om de juiste dingen voor elkaar te krijgen. Daarvoor zoek je de samenwerking. Een dosis pragmatiek is jou hierbij niet vreemd. Je communiceert makkelijk, bent organisatiesensitief en kunt schakelen met diverse stakeholders. Tenslotte ben je klant- en resultaatgericht en een kei in samenwerken.

Opleiding/kennis

Minimaal HBO werk- en denkniveau;
Test Proces Improvement (TPI), Test Specificatie Technieken en Test Management Methodiek (TMAP);
Certificering op TMAP Professional advanced;
Kennis van het vakgebied Functioneel ontwerp;
Kennis van relevante tooling (Jira, AzureDevops, SQL);

Minstens drie jaar ervaring als Testengineer op medior-niveau;
Ervaring met Agile werken;
Ervaring met testautomatisering (Robot Framework);
Ervaring met softwaretestmethoden en testmanagement (waaronder teststrategie, risicotaxatie);
Kennis en ervaring met de theorieën, methoden en instrumenten van dit specialistische vakgebied;
Ervaring met Informatievoorziening (inclusief applicaties);

Soft skills

Communicatief ben je sterk naar verschillende partijen;
Je kunt je verplaatsen in de positie van de gebruiker en diens behoefte;
Je hebt een proactieve houding. 

Indien je aantoonbaar beschikt over ervaring en benodigde competenties is inzet als Testengineer III (senior) mogelijk, hiervoor bied jij:

Minimaal drie jaar ervaring als senior Testengineer. 
Een flexibele werkhouding; je kunt goed omgaan met werken onder druk; je bent zelfredzaam, geeft specialistisch advies en je toont initiatief;
Deploymentbeheer (RUN: Het plannen, begeleiden en monitoren van software releases van agile ontwikkelteams om releases naar productie omgevingen te kunnen faciliteren. 
Je coacht collega’s indien nodig bij testwerkzaamheden. 
Bepaalt welke testen geautomatiseerd kunnen worden, beargumenteert waar dit niet wenselijk is. 
Bepaalt of de kwaliteit van het product in relatie tot de requirements voldoende is vanuit het perspectief van de tester om het in productie te nemen en geeft hierover advies richting het team. 
Levert demo’s aan de klant. 
Geeft voorbeeldgedrag op het gebied van: klantgerichtheid; samenwerken; resultaatgerichtheid; én benoemt op basis van ordening van informatie trends, effecten en risico’s.

Bij het CBBS-team kom je in een professioneel en hecht team te werken. Wij bieden jou een afwisselende functie waarin samenwerken en uitdagingen voorop staan. Ben jij de Platform Engineer die ons cloudplatform naar het volgende niveau tilt? Bij Cyso Cloud bouwen en beheren we een volledig Europees, GDPR-compliant cloudplatform waar organisaties blindelings op kunnen vertrouwen. This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager based in Netherlands.

You will support engineering leadership by overseeing work across central services, DevOps, and data teams in a real-money gaming environment. Your mission will be to bring clarity, structure, and accountability to engineering operations while ensuring priorities and releases remain aligned. You will combine software engineering expertise with program management, automation, and data-driven reporting to improve how teams collaborate. You will also lead a small team of contract engineers and help establish scalable workflows. Accountabilities

You will coordinate cross-functional engineering delivery, improve operational efficiency, and ensure teams have clear priorities, ownership, and visibility into progress.

Manage intake and triage for central services, DevOps, and data teams, determining request ownership, priorities, and delivery timelines.

Develop consolidated dashboards that provide visibility into applications, infrastructure, data systems, and release progress, bringing together information from multiple sources.

Professional software development experience, with a subsequent focus on technical program management or delivery coordination.

A calm, dependable leadership style that encourages early communication and proactive problem-solving.

Job Description:
About Xyall
Xyall develops the Tissector, an instrument that automates tissue dissection for molecular pathology. It locates the tumor area marked by a pathologist on a glass slide and collects the selected tissue for molecular testing. Our systems are used in research laboratories and hospitals around the world.

About the role
As a Junior Software Engineer, you will join a small software team working on software that interacts directly with physical devices, cameras and laboratory systems. Your work will include developing new functionality, testing it on our instruments and investigating issues across software and hardware.

We are open to both recent graduates with strong programming experience from university or personal projects and junior engineers with a few years of professional experience. What matters most is that you have a good foundation in Python, are curious about how things work and want to develop beyond purely web-based software.

You will work closely with experienced engineers and gradually take ownership of larger parts of the system. Because working with and testing on our instruments is an important part of the role, this position is based on-site at our Eindhoven office. 

Tasks & responsibilities
· Develop and maintain software components in Python and .NET, with guidance from experienced engineers.
· Write unit and developer-level tests and test your work on Xyall's physical systems.
· Investigate and debug software issues found during development, system integration, testing and at customer sites.
· Work with software that interacts with cameras, hardware components and laboratory systems.
· Participate in code reviews and learn from feedback from other engineers.
· Keep your work traceable through code, tests and technical documentation in line with our medical-device development process.
· Work closely with colleagues in Software, Hardware, Quality and Service to bring functionality from requirement to release.
· Use approved AI tools to support development, testing, analysis and documentation while remaining responsible for the quality and correctness of your work.
· Contribute ideas for improving our software, testing and development processes.


Requirements
A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Embedded Systems or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
Hands-on programming experience with Python, gained through professional experience, internships, university projects or personal projects.
Up to approximately 3 years of professional software development experience. Recent graduates are welcome to apply.
A good understanding of software development fundamentals, debugging and testing.
Familiarity with Git and collaborative software development.
Interest in working with software that interacts with physical systems and hardware, rather than purely web-based applications.
Good English communication skills; Dutch is a plus.
Experience with C#/.NET, embedded systems, robotics, computer vision, industrial automation or regulated software development is an advantage, but not required.

Who are you
You are curious and eager to learn. When you don't know something, you investigate, experiment and ask questions rather than waiting for someone to give you the answer.

You enjoy solving problems and understanding how things work beyond the software itself. You're comfortable when not everything is defined in advance and can adapt when priorities change.

At the same time, you work carefully and understand that when software is part of a medical device, reliable code, testing and documentation matter.

You enjoy working with others but are also able to take ownership of a task and make progress independently.

What we offer
· The opportunity to develop software that runs on real medical devices used in cancer research and molecular pathology.
· Close collaboration with experienced software engineers and specialists from Hardware, Quality and Service.
· Modern AI coding tools as part of the development workflow within a controlled engineering process.
· A small team where your contribution is visible and where you can gradually take ownership of larger parts of the system.
· Full-time employment, 40 hours per week.

Job Description:
The Role

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join the Document Intelligence Team. Our vision is to become the document knowledge platform for DataSnipper — a shared, cloud-native foundation where every document and everything we extract from it becomes a durable, reusable asset that powers our agents and other products.

This is a hands-on engineering role in a high-caliber team that moves fast and holds a high bar. You will build and maintain the ingestion, processing, and extraction pipelines and the platform services that expose them, contribute to architectural decisions, and deliver core parts of the document intelligence platform at DataSnipper.

You will work closely with Product, Agent teams, and fellow engineers to deliver high-quality, production-ready solutions.

About DataSnipper

Audit and finance are still massively manual — and we’re changing that.

DataSnipper is a $1B, bootstrapped unicorn with 600,000+ users across 180+ countries, already embedded in the daily workflows of top audit and accounting firms. Now, we’re taking things further with our Excel Agent — bringing AI directly into where the work actually happens.

Unlike generic AI tools, we don’t sit on the sidelines. Our AI operates inside Excel, with access to real documents and audit evidence — meaning it doesn’t just generate answers, it does the work, with full traceability.

We’re not just applying AI — we’re redefining how audit gets done. If you want to build something category-defining at scale, this is the place.

What You Will Do

Technical Delivery

Build and maintain components of the document intelligence platform that deliver best-in-class accuracy, speed, and reliability, with design direction from senior engineers
Build and maintain the platform APIs and services that expose documents and their extracted intelligence as shared, reusable capabilities for multiple products and workflows
Help build and operate the cloud document store: a secure, managed store for every document we ingest plus everything we extract, with the metadata, retrieval patterns, and traceability that downstream intelligence requires
Integrate with AI service providers to power document understanding at scale
Build AI- and ML-powered extraction capabilities
Work within the integration contracts between platform APIs and consuming teams, and flag gaps early

Architecture & Quality

Apply well-established design principles within an existing architecture, accounting for document-heavy use cases (large PDFs, mixed formats, high-volume batches)
Participate in code reviews and follow team best practices
Build and use quality metrics; repeatable pipelines that score extraction quality on representative production documents to identify gaps and drive measurable improvements
Implement the security and compliance requirements defined for document handling (retention, deletion, access controls, auditability, and regional requirements)

Collaboration & Impact

Break down your own work into deliverable increments and surface cross-team dependencies early
Work with product partners to clarify requirements for your workstream and simplify technical approaches
Foster a culture of documentation and knowledge sharing within the team and with business stakeholders
Integrate AI tools into workflows, critically evaluate AI outputs, and contribute to team-level AI adoption

What You Will Bring

Must-Have

4–6 years in software engineering, with strong proficiency in C# and/or Python and its ecosystem and tooling
Experience contributing to backend services in production on any cloud platform (we are on Azure)
Experience working on distributed or data-intensive systems
Proficient with AI-assisted Engineering (we use Claude Code)
Experience with testing strategies (unit, integration, E2E) and a quality-first mindset
Excellent communication and collaboration skills
Comfortable working across the stack: either full-stack experience, or strong backend with genuine willingness to contribute to frontend work

Nice-to-Have

Experience with document processing, analysis, or storage technologies and pipelines
Experience building platform or shared-service capabilities consumed by multiple internal teams and external partners
Experience with Azure services (AI Foundry, Container Apps, Service Bus, Blob storage, Content Understanding)
Experience with LLM-based document understanding and evaluation

What We Expect

Ownership: You own well-scoped work end-to-end, anticipate issues, and ask for guidance on ambiguous decisions
Growth Mindset: You encourage open feedback exchange and provide clear, balanced feedback that helps others grow
Collaboration: You build strong cross-functional relationships and communicate clearly across functions
Adaptability: You navigate ambiguity calmly, model positive behavior, and help peers adjust through clear communication
Judgment: You escalate early, ask good questions, and deliver reliably against agreed priorities

What We Offer

Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact
Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share the company's success and growth
Excellent salary package, competitive for top tech talent
Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary
28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance
Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office
Daily, freshly prepared lunches by our in-house chef to keep you energized
Parking and NS card for easy commuting to the office
Access to continuous learning and development initiatives to grow your skills
Engage with a vibrant international team spread across five global offices
Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO where global teams come together
Access to OpenUp, a mental health and wellness platform supporting your wellbeing
Friday drinks and various social activities are designed for team bonding and fun

At DataSnipper, we believe great ideas come from different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. We’re committed to building an inclusive workplace and providing a fair and equitable hiring experience for every candidate.

We welcome applicants regardless of age, race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes you, you.

What matters to us is your potential, your experience, and what you can bring to the team!

Job Description:
At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car, a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton, Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe, we encounter exceptional objects every day.

We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.

Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.

Taking ownership and driving impact 
Being open to change and feedback
Being passionate about our mission and our customers. 

About The Role And Team

As our Security Tech Lead Manager, you’ll manage a team of 2–3 security engineers within Platform Engineering and remain hands-on. You’ll own the security engineering roadmap and take responsibility for the team’s delivery, performance and development. Working with Product and Platform Engineering, you’ll help protect our marketplace, our customers and their data.

Our platform runs on Google Cloud and Kubernetes. You’ll focus on application and cloud security, secure software delivery and risks in internal and AI-enabled systems. You’ll turn security priorities into engineering work, make clear trade-offs and help teams adopt controls that fit their everyday workflows.

What You Will Do

Manage and develop the security team through regular one-to-ones, timely feedback, performance reviews and career development. Address underperformance and support hiring and onboarding.
Own the security engineering roadmap. Prioritise work based on risk, business needs and team capacity, delegate effectively and remove blockers to delivery.
Stay hands-on by building security controls and automation, reviewing code and guiding technical decisions across applications, cloud infrastructure and software delivery.
Partner with Product and Platform Engineering early in design. Lead threat modelling and security reviews, and help teams choose secure approaches that are practical to implement.
Improve vulnerability management. Assess findings in the context of exposure and business impact, agree remediation priorities with system owners and track issues through resolution.
Improve security checks in CI/CD and infrastructure as code, including dependency and secret scanning. Reduce false positives and help engineers act on findings.
Coordinate the security team’s technical contribution to incident response and investigations. Turn lessons from incidents into improvements to detection, response and preventive controls.
Work with Legal, IT and Trust & Safety on security controls, policies and audit evidence where responsibilities overlap.
Measure and communicate progress through remediation times, control coverage and adoption. Explain remaining risks, delivery progress and trade-offs to technical and business stakeholders.

Who You Are

You have substantial hands-on security engineering experience in a software or cloud environment and have implemented and operated security capabilities in production.
You have previously managed engineers as direct reports, including performance reviews, career development and difficult feedback. You can balance people management with technical contribution.
You have owned a security roadmap or programme, translated priorities into deliverable work and coordinated implementation across engineering teams.
You have strong knowledge of application and cloud security, including identity and access management, secrets management and secure software development.
You are experienced in threat modelling, secure code and design reviews, vulnerability prioritisation and practical incident response.
You can develop or automate in Ruby, Python, Go or a similar language, are comfortable reviewing backend code and have integrated security controls into engineering workflows.
You communicate clearly with engineers and non-technical partners, explain risk in business terms and gain support for decisions when priorities compete.

Helpful Experience

Experience with Google Cloud, Kubernetes and Terraform or similar infrastructure tooling.
Experience in a marketplace, e-commerce or another software product business, including account and API security.
Experience securing AI-enabled applications, agents or data pipelines, or using AI to improve security engineering workflows.

Why You'll Love Working with Us

Create a visible impact by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.
Learn and grow through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression.
A culture of connection defines us. We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work.
Celebrate life’s moments with us. You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion”. We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location.

Our Offices and Way of Working

Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based.
